bull.b: Elfabrio is generating growing commercial sales while additional geographic and dosing approvals expand its potential reach. Broader authorization and the once-every-four-weeks option can support adoption, strengthen the product’s market position, and improve recurring revenue potential.

The return to meaningful profitability and strong reported margins indicates that the commercial business can generate earnings at its current scale. If product sales remain established, this earnings base can support investment in the pipeline and reduce reliance on external financing.

A $40.7M cash position alongside no debt or warrants gives Protalix financial flexibility to fund operations, commercial activity, and clinical development. The absence of debt service obligations also reduces balance-sheet pressure while the company advances its pipeline.

bear.b: Dependence on Chiesi and uneven partner purchasing can make reported revenue volatile even when underlying product demand is developing. This concentration reduces near-term forecasting visibility and leaves results sensitive to partner inventory decisions and shipment timing.

The $25M milestone materially supported first-half results but may not recur, making recent growth and profitability less representative of ongoing product economics. Future performance will therefore need to be supported increasingly by repeat Elfabrio sales rather than exceptional payments.

The high observed anti-drug antibody rate, together with unresolved dose and regimen selection, creates meaningful uncertainty for PRX-115’s development path. Immunogenicity and infusion concerns could complicate advancement, delay milestones, and affect eventual market positioning.
